activities.name: A Burning Memory
activities.description: §7Corruption's grasp is tight around its most powerful assets. §c✖§7 Crossed The Great Bridge

activities.name: Abandoned Sentinels
activities.description: §7The old custodians of Gavel now fail to differentiate friend and foe. Some proclaim them to be soldiers of the first men, still fighting a battle long after their creators died.

activities.name: Aeon Origin
activities.description: §7Things of lost antiquity and impossible futures converge at a single point, entangled in the knotted threads of the Time Valley.

activities.name: Ahms Monuments
activities.description: §7Some archaic sculptures and effigies have resisted both time and The Fracturing.

activities.name: All Eyes on Me
activities.description: §7The focus of their attention is set upon you.

activities.name: Apiary Hive
activities.description: §7Symbiosis creates new opportunities for animals and people alike, as regular migrations of wasps and bees can be taken advantage of.

activities.name: Approaching Raid
activities.description: §7Sieges from undead forces are all but uncommon to soldiers of Wynn.

activities.name: Arachnid Ambush
activities.description: §7Some broods of spiders lie in wait for a meal to fall into their jaws. Those who stray from the path often end up as an arachnid's dinner.

activities.name: Autumn Poachers
activities.description: §7Though most people in the Auburn Forest hold a respect for the nature around them, there are some that have no such reverence.

activities.name: Biohazardous Bloom
activities.description: §7The pollution of the Roughworks gives rise to mobile colonies of algae, slime, and septic detritus from the waterways. Cleaning it is a disgustingly necessary, and horrifically dangerous job.

activities.name: Blazing Combustion
activities.description: §7The heat of Corruption is great enough that even earth and stone burns. Some compare the way that the earth is scalded to the point of being seared to a rash, spreading its way across Wynn.

activities.name: Blood-Encrusted Mastaba
activities.description: §7Excavations to unearth the tombs of the lost empire are a risk to the archeologists performing them. With enough luck, priceless relics telling ancient stories can be uncovered, but with misfortune, you might find that the entombed dead waiting for you to unbury them.

activities.name: Bowels of the Roots
activities.description: §7Plunge yourself into the burning guts of the corruption, and its destructive forces will come to greet you.

activities.name: Bubbling Terrace
activities.description: §7At the fringes of the Molten Heights, uniquely curious creatures form where molten rock and boiling water collide.

activities.name: Canine Ambush
activities.description: §7Some legends say that Bob's death has the native wolves of the Nesaak Tundra to blame, and while many would dispute the validity of this fable, there is no denying the sheer ferocity these prowling hunters possess.

activities.name: Citadel Barracks
activities.description: §7The Gendarme are the Crown's most loyal soldiers, unflinchingly accepting orders. The most dangerous enemy is one unafraid to die for their cause.

activities.name: Colossi Ingrain
activities.description: §7Ingrained in the earth, fragments of the Colossus wreak havoc in all corners of the crumbling land it oversees.

activities.name: Corrupted Spring
activities.description: §7Cursed magma rises to the surface from deep within the root network of the Corruption.

activities.name: Dark Deacons
activities.description: §7A mysterious cult is gathering inside a cave, whispering furtive secrets and dark incantations.

activities.name: Decommissioned War Machines
activities.description: §7Old machines built for battle have been repurposed by Antikythera in its campaign for alleged "peace".

activities.name: Desperate Ambush
activities.description: §7A witch has been sighted in the swamp, toying with forces way beyond her control.

activities.name: Despermech Occupation
activities.description: §7Decrepit machines scrounge for parts to mend themselves and create more of their kind.

activities.name: Encroaching Ablation
activities.description: §7Corrupted forces gather to thaw Theorick's spell and push further into Nesaak.

activities.name: Encroaching Blaze
activities.description: §7Corrupted forces gather to make the forests ash.

activities.name: Encroaching Conflagration
activities.description: §7Corrupted forces gather to scar the earth with war.

activities.name: Encroaching Destruction
activities.description: §7Corrupted forces gather to lay claim to their battlefields.

activities.name: Encroaching Extinction
activities.description: §7Corrupted forces gather to bring an end to all life. §c✖§7 Crossed The Great Bridge

activities.name: Encroaching Misery
activities.description: §7Corrupted forces gather to revel in their conquest.

activities.name: Encroaching Reanimation
activities.description: §7Corrupted forces gather to pull the dead from the burning sands.

activities.name: Enraged Eagle
activities.description: §7Territorial birds make explorers who wish to navigate the twisting paths of the Canyon of the Lost's jobs somehow even harder.

activities.name: Failed Hunt
activities.description: §7The allure of wealth and pride draws in the foolhardy for what they believe is an easy hunt.

activities.name: Fossil Fighters
activities.description: §7Saurians of the Mistwoods regularly gather, clashing over food and mates. The Mistwoods clans normally steer clear of these dangerous events, but sometimes the allure of the valuable Saurian parts is too great to ignore.

activities.name: Glacial Training
activities.description: §7The rigorous training regimen of the Fruman military requires its recruits to be able to survive in even the harshest conditions.

activities.name: Haywire Defender
activities.description: §7What instructions the old constructs were given have been long forgotten, and now they attack all that come across their path with indiscriminate hatred.

activities.name: Improper Burial Rites
activities.description: §7A failure to put the dead to rest oft leads to their grim return. Mummified remains from a civilization lost to time crawl their way out from their sandy graves to lay waste to the desert their kingdom has become.

activities.name: Incomprehensible Cynosure
activities.description: §7Forfeit all reason and succumb to the ineffable things scraping against this world.

activities.name: Infernal Caldera
activities.description: §7Overpowering heat emanates from the top of this volcano, threatening to erupt.

activities.name: Karoshi Union
activities.description: §7Ground under the wheel of infinite production, many industrial workers lose sight of themselves, the world around them, anything but the job before them.

activities.name: Light Emissaries
activities.description: §7With the encroaching decay, wardens of Light have taken it upon themselves to purge their lands of all foreign things.

activities.name: Lonely Islet
activities.description: §7Before the waves were calmed, the ocean was left unexplored for many years. Even now, there are lonely patches of land that remain undiscovered by all but the most savvy sailors.

activities.name: Maar Ashpit
activities.description: §7Whatever was once here has been almost entirely reduced to ashes, leaving a small desert of suffocating cremation.

activities.name: Mole Meet-Up
activities.description: §7Mountainous colonies of moles are thought to be responsible for regular avalanches in the snowiest parts of the highlands.

activities.name: Monument to Loss
activities.description: §7Sit long enough in the valley, and you will watch as reality is eaten away, piece by piece... until there is nothing left.

activities.name: Necromantic Site
activities.description: §7The emergence of the Corruption in Wynn has turned once solemn graveyards into rotten armies.

activities.name: Otherworldly Exhibition
activities.description: §7Wounds in the world left by indomitable hunger create unseen passageways for strange and impossible things to wriggle their way into reality. The most deranged see beauty in this indescribable merging of existences.

activities.name: Overtaken Farm
activities.description: §7Scarecrows have begun scaring far more than pesky birds. Corruption has given these straw-men a newfound resentment for life.

activities.name: Palace Guards
activities.description: §7Aelumia's Grand Palace is guarded heavily. Fortunate few get to lay witness to its military parades. To be a rebel within those demonstrations is certain death.

activities.name: Patrolling Soldiers
activities.description: §7Fruman military patrols are a regular sight in all regions of the province, led by the elite Wings to keep the population safe and in check.

activities.name: Peculiar Grotto
activities.description: §7Fungal organisms are made wild and vibrant by Light, warping them into sentient, polychromatic growths.

activities.name: Pestilential Downpour
activities.description: §7Nuclear residue and bile coalesce in the clouds, and then rain down in an acidic shower of flesh-melting fluid. The wastes are cleansed in a torrent of vomit and radioactive effluent.

activities.name: Prelude to Annihilation
activities.description: §7Something from the other side roars through the portal with a hatred for all life. Annihilation is coming to the physical plane.

activities.name: Realmic Antigen
activities.description: §7The Realm's immune response sees all that is unfamiliar as disease to be cleansed.

activities.name: Risen Return
activities.description: §7A true death is rare in Wynn, for the corruption forbids any real demise.

activities.name: Rogue Wyrmling
activities.description: §7A child of the Grootslang has gone rogue from its kin, wracked by decay.

activities.name: Royal Alchemists
activities.description: §7The Fruman regime is eager to display its advancements to the citadel's populace in order to ensure its people are not tempted into trying magic.

activities.name: Ruff & Tumble
activities.description: §7The constantly shifting walls of The Canyon of the Lost leave the region prone to rockslides, uncovering old creatures of stone that were left slumbering in the earth.

activities.name: Shapes in the Dark
activities.description: §7Plunge yourself into a darkness darker than darkness, and let unspeakable things reveal themselves to you.

activities.name: Shattered Roosts
activities.description: §7Remains of the Ahms region float high over the void, becoming roosts to avians of all kinds.

activities.name: Skittering Spiders
activities.description: §7A swarm of spiders have made a home among the mushrooms, deep in the Nivla Woods. §c✖§7 Offered to help Yahya

activities.name: Slimy Schism
activities.description: §7Slimes gather to congeal, curdle, and split into new oozes. The acrid smell of their sticky conclave is overpowering. §c✖§7 Crossed The Great Bridge

activities.name: Stackpeak Pinnacle
activities.description: §7The peaks of Stackpeak reach high above the clouds, where local avians fiercely guard their young.

activities.name: Steel Skirmish
activities.description: §7A massive presence of military might is required to keep watch over such a sprawling cityscape as the Industrial District.

activities.name: Swampland Squabble
activities.description: §7The rumors milling around the bog keep all but the most adventurous and desperate in the Auburn region away from its muddy waters.

activities.name: Swashbuckling Brawl
activities.description: §7Though these pirates are long past their prime, their shambling remains still follow the barked orders of their rotten captain.

activities.name: Tainted Shoreline
activities.description: §7Corruption's grasp stretches to even the furthest bounds of the Wynn Province. Though it is a myth that Corruption cannot pass through great bodies of water like the ocean, the kernel of truth is that it struggles to cross the gap, to the relief of all who live off shore.

activities.name: Territorial Trolls
activities.description: §7With the canyon ever-shifting, bands of Trolls that lay claim to certain regions must constantly migrate to stay within their borders.

activities.name: Tree-Top Cradle
activities.description: §7Many birds native to the Highlands are not restricted by established borders like those below, and can often be found roosting amongst the tree-tops of the neighboring Mistwoods.

activities.name: Unsettling Encounters
activities.description: §7From the decay of the earth, new leprous things grow from its rotten carcass.

activities.name: Visit from Beyond
activities.description: §7Emissaries of Darkness seek to incarcerate the damned, and bind their spirits to the world.

§7This recluse gap in reality has laid unknown to all but a few for an immeasurable amount of time. Within its walls lies a colossal hole in the barrier between realms, and within that hole lies an anomalous, otherworldly entity responsible for the creation of the Void Holes that scatter the Silent Expanse.

activities.name: Abandoned Lumber Yard
activities.description: §7Hundreds of years ago, the people working at this mill died in the war. Even after the land was frozen over, their bodies still hunt those who draw near.

activities.name: Abandoned Mines
activities.description: §7Despite mining opening up the infamous portal, it did not stop. Some speculate that these mines are hiding an even greater danger...

activities.name: Aelumia Citadel
activities.description: §7Fruma's shining capital, Aelumia Citadel, stands strong atop the central plateau, overlooking the entire province. Though citizens enjoy a life free of oppression, the paranoid government keeps rigid surveillance systems to ensure nobody steps too far out of line.

activities.name: Aerie of the Recluse
activities.description: §7This lush, open-air cavern is home to a secluded pair of Avos. They have some kind of vendetta against humans... it may be best to leave them be.

activities.name: Ahmsord
activities.description: §7The central city of the Sky Islands, Ahmsord is home to the wealthiest of traders, and the most revered of adventurers.

activities.name: Aldorei Town
activities.description: §7Aldorei Town is another section of the elf city, housing many special resources and charms not found anywhere else in Gavel.

activities.name: Aldorei Valley
activities.description: §7Very few outsiders are allowed into Aldorei Valley, home of the elves. They consider it to be a place free of greed.

activities.name: Aldwell
activities.description: §7Though this community seems warm and welcoming, something isn't quite right. An air of paranoia is constantly present.

activities.name: Alekin Village
activities.description: §7A small village hidden within the trees in Nivla Woods. It acts as a respite for travelers, as the midpoint between Ragni and Detlas.

activities.name: Almuj
activities.description: §7Even in the harsh desert, people have found a way to survive. The massive city of Almuj uses the nearby water sources to keep its city a thriving oasis.

activities.name: Almuj Great River
activities.description: §7Despite its barren surroundings, this river has sprouted various plant life. It flows straight into the Rymek Canyon.

activities.name: Altar of Sanctification
activities.description: §7A heavy aura hangs in the air of this disused tribal exorcism site. The gibbering of a lingering spirit has begun to echo in your ears...

activities.name: Ancient Nemract
activities.description: §7Hundreds of years ago, the original stone city of Nemract was ravaged by a swarm of the undead. Now it is only inhabited by the corpses of those who died that day.

activities.name: Arena of the Legends
activities.description: §7An arena for those who wish to truly test their mettle after being admitted into the Temple of the Legends, where fierce training takes place.

activities.name: Auburn Forest
activities.description: §7A shortage of water has caused this forest to exist in an eternal autumn. The poorest region in Fruma, its inhabitants manage an economy of their own based on bartering, allowing them a better quality of life.

activities.name: Avos Territory
activities.description: §7Home of the bird-like Avos, the native inhabitants of Corkus. Though they welcomed the Corkians initially, tensions between the two have grown over the years.

activities.name: Bantisu Air Temple
activities.description: §7Bantisu Air Temple has served as a beacon in the Canyon of The Lost. The Air Monks help guide people who have gotten lost.

activities.name: Bear Zoo
activities.description: §7This strange island is home to the province's one and only zoo. The owner thought out in the ocean the creatures would be safe from the corruption, but the zoo doesn't get many visitors.

activities.name: Black Road
activities.description: §7This road leads to the town of Ternaves and its nearby mine. It is inhabited by strange mushroom-cow hybrids, and a mysterious scientist.

activities.name: Bob's Tomb
activities.description: §7A year after Bob's disappearance, a tomb pertaining to the resting place of Bob was found in 985 AP.

activities.name: Bottomless Pit
activities.description: §7An intense well of gravity sits atop the border of the void, drawing in anything fallen into it. Creatures seem to still live down here...

activities.name: Bovine Barn
activities.description: §7A lush cavern hidden under the barn at Durum Isles. It is bursting with life and natural energies, and is fiercely protected...

activities.name: Bremminglar
activities.description: §7Not many travel to this little tribal town in the savannah, but it is said to be the home of a powerful sorcerer.

activities.name: Bremmyn-Hierra
activities.description: §7Sandblasted by desert winds, the ancient mountain of Bremmyn-Hierra stands cracked but tall above the savanna plains, a guiding mark for many.

activities.name: Bucie
activities.description: §7The small town of Bucie is home to many farmers, who produce the crops for the nearby cities of Llevigar and Olux.

activities.name: Caritat Mansion
activities.description: §7Once the home of the Caritat family, the most wealthy and generous family in the forest, until one day they mysteriously vanished.

activities.name: Carnivorous Creature
activities.description: §7This ravenous plant is truly one of a kind. Many creatures have lived hundreds of years beyond their natural lifespan due to the influence of darkness.

activities.name: Castle Dullahan
activities.description: §7Once the home of a wealthy aristocrat, this castle has been overtaken by Dullahan, an enigmatic Elf who terrorized the Dark Forest for decades.

activities.name: Centerworld Fortress
activities.description: §7The largest Orc base in Gavel, this fortress was once considered the heart of Orcish territory. It still serves as a capital, and is strictly defended.

activities.name: Challenge of the Blades
activities.description: §7Pure dark magic is all that exists in this magical trap, laid by a sadistic denizen from the Realm of Darkness.

activities.name: Cinfras
activities.description: §7The city of Cinfras is the central hub of the Gavel Province. It is also home of the massive Guild Hall, and a massive airship travel center.

activities.name: Corkus City
activities.description: §7The main city of the patriotic Corkians, refugees from Fruma who settled on the island. They've used the art of electromagic to build machines.

activities.name: Crystal Falls
activities.description: §7The elegant Crystal Falls decorate the scenery around the dojo of Sensei Miyagi, a wise teacher who has trained hundreds of apprentices.

activities.name: Dark Forest Gate
activities.description: §7Once a grand stone entryway to a brilliant forest, it has since fallen into disrepair since the emergence of the Decay.

activities.name: Dark Obelisk
activities.description: §7This black obelisk bears a similar shape to the one found in Lutho, though it's unclear how they're related.

activities.name: Dead Island
activities.description: §7A wealthy family claimed the entire island to settle on when the waves first settled, but a mysterious event has brought dark influence to the island, robbing it of its vibrancy.

activities.name: Death's Realm
activities.description: §7Devoid of color, all the souls of the dead will make their way to here, the realm of the dead.

activities.name: Delnar Manor
activities.description: §7A prestigious mansion that was once owned by the Sodeta Guild. It is said that the dangerous and powerful Abysso Galoshes were once sealed away here.

activities.name: Deserter's Refuge
activities.description: §7The lavish halls of these barracks are one of the few places in the Citadel that the lighthouse's piercing gaze cannot reach inside of. As only soldiers are permitted to enter, none have heard the maniacal whisperings that now fill them.

activities.name: Detlas
activities.description: §7The center of the Wynn Province. This city is a massive hub of trade for all adventurers, whether they have just started their journey or have been at it their whole lives.

activities.name: Detlas Suburbs
activities.description: §7This area is heavily defended by the armies of Detlas and Ragni to ensure food production continues.

activities.name: Dogun's Retreat
activities.description: §7The tiny survivor population of Doguns fled to the surface after the subterranean war. They are ill suited to living above ground.

activities.name: Dragon Skeleton
activities.description: §7Remnant of the Dogun genocide, the Dragons sided with the native residents. However, the dwarves proved to be the dominant force beneath the lava.

activities.name: Durum Isles
activities.description: §7Despite the odd formation of land, every inch is covered in farmland, and acts as a proverbial breadbasket for the ocean capital of Selchar.

activities.name: Eagle Tribe
activities.description: §7The Eagle Tribe is one of the two native tribes of the Rymek Canyon. They have been at war with the Owl Tribe for years.

activities.name: Efilim
activities.description: §7Unlike most towns in Gavel, Efilim is home to multiple races. Elves and villagers live together in harmony here.

activities.name: Elkurn
activities.description: §7Despite its proximity to the portal, this quaint town has somehow managed to survive. Its placement near two separate magical phenomena has led to an influx of scientific minds to the area.

activities.name: Eltom
activities.description: §7The city of Eltom is the only human residence in Gavel. Since humans aren't permitted to settle in the province, it has remained hidden to outsiders.

activities.name: Emerald Trail
activities.description: §7The trail through Nivla Woods to Detlas, the central city of the Wynn Province.

activities.name: Entamis Village
activities.description: §7A native tribe of the Dernel Jungle resides here. Its people revere the tree in the village's center as their guardian.

activities.name: Espren
activities.description: §7Despite being Fruma's poorest city, the people of Espren get by through their strong sense of community, and faith in their spiritual guardians.

activities.name: Eyeball Forest
activities.description: §7The trees of this forest are unlike any seen in the rest of the Wynn Province, and give many travellers the feeling that they're being watched...

activities.name: Fallen Factory
activities.description: §7This massive factory, built by the engineer Cerid, was once hailed as the national monument of Corkus. Ever since it was closed down, it has fallen into disrepair.

activities.name: Faltach Manor
activities.description: §7No one ever dares to go near this abandoned manor, even though only a few know of its shrouded past. Some have gone as far to say that they can hear something... or someone... calling to them from within.

activities.name: Feuding Houses
activities.description: §7The noble houses Nasin and Thalas have long held great influence over the province, bearing many of Fruma's past Sovereigns. For hundreds of years, they have maintained a bitter rivalry, always attempting to one-up each other.

activities.name: Fort Hegea
activities.description: §7While most Military activity in the Mistwoods takes place in the outskirts of the forest, this fort is an anomaly, hidden in the deepest reaches of the region. One can only wonder what clandestine activity would require something so covert.

activities.name: Fort Tericen
activities.description: §7Fort Tericen is one of Fruma's most important military fortresses, being home to the province's largest military academy. Recruits are brought from all across the province to be trained here.

activities.name: Fort Torann
activities.description: §7Behind the Royal Gate lies the largest military fortress in Fruma, Fort Torann. It is built to protect the province from intruders, and all who enter or leave must pass through it.

activities.name: Fountain of Youth
activities.description: §7It is said that each province has a magical spring that grants people eternal life.

activities.name: Freezing Heights
activities.description: §7Cursed by an ice dragon's breath, this is a scar of the Dogun genocide.

activities.name: Gavel Gate
activities.description: §7This massive doorway serves as the main entrance to the province of Gavel. Through it lies the quartz city of Llevigar.

activities.name: Gelibord
activities.description: §7Despite the Decay, Gelibord has gotten by. Due to its trade industry, it's become a good stop for adventurers on their quest through Gavel.

activities.name: Gert Camp
activities.description: §7Home of the Gerts, a race of hunger fuelled orange-headed brutes. Though they aren't very intelligent, they are still a force to be reckoned with.

activities.name: Geyser Pit
activities.description: §7Desperate for resources, the mining mechs of Corkus have begun digging to bedrock. The magma layers aren't far below.

activities.name: Gylia Watch Tower
activities.description: §7Founded after the Gerten War 200 years ago, the Gylia Watch have used this tower as their base, keeping an eye on the Gerts to prevent another attack.

activities.name: Half-Moon Island
activities.description: §7This island is home to some form of cult, obsessed with the moon and its power. Rumours fly about it, a common thought being that they are attempting to summon some form of lunar deity.

activities.name: House of Talor
activities.description: §7This once grand cathedral has begun to fall into disrepair over the years as the effects of the Decay worsened. Nevertheless, the church still continues to provide blessings and protection to the Kander Forest's inhabitants.

activities.name: Hyloch
activities.description: §7Those who are not rich enough to afford their own mansions live here in Hyloch, by the vast lakes. Its people live in bliss, ignorant to the suffering of their countrymen in the lower regions.

activities.name: Iboju Village
activities.description: §7The village of the native tribe of the jungle. The people here have lived peacefully alongside the people of Troms for years.

activities.name: Ice Islands
activities.description: §7Home to a nation of early seafarers, they have waged war among each other for years, oblivious to the real war happening on the mainland.

activities.name: Invaded Barracks
activities.description: §7Once the barracks of the Almuj Army, it has been taken over by the traitorous rebel, Commander Takan.

activities.name: Iron Golem Factory
activities.description: §7The source of the Iron Golems protecting Wynn and Gavel, and the methods of creating them, have remained unknown to the public eye.

activities.name: Isles of Fiction
activities.description: §7Previously only an empty stretch of ocean, this strange set of islands suddenly appeared to fill the space, seemingly out of nowhere. A strange magic fills the air.

activities.name: Jofash Docks
activities.description: §7A port town filled with odd residents and drunken sailors, Jofash Docks is the only entryway to Gavel outside of the main gate.

activities.name: Jofash Tunnel
activities.description: §7This dark tunnel connects the Sky Islands of Gavel to the Jofash Docks on the province's eastern coast, for those who wish to go sailing.

activities.name: Kandon-Beda
activities.description: §7A town built on the edge of a cliff, Kandon-Beda specializes in air travel. It also houses a library for those who wish to learn history.

activities.name: Karoc Quarry
activities.description: §7Karoc Quarry mines out massive amounts of quartz each day, mostly used for construction purposes. But lately, shipments have been going missing...

activities.name: Katoa Ranch
activities.description: §7This farm is most famous for its milk, though recently the cows that produce it have been going missing.

activities.name: Kitrios Barracks
activities.description: §7These barracks are where the Cinfras Army is positioned, though lately their General has been acting suspicious...

activities.name: Lake Gylia
activities.description: §7Named after the lush plains preceding it, Lake Gylia is the largest lake in the world. Immense magical energy surrounds this place.

activities.name: Lazarus Pit
activities.description: §7Gavel's counterpart to Wynn's Fountain of Youth, the Lazarus Pit has been resurrecting the dead inmates of the nearby prison.

activities.name: Legendary Island
activities.description: §7Home of the Legendary Challenge, a test for those who think that they are the strongest in the world. It is named for its designer, the eccentric Dr. Legendary.

activities.name: Letvus Airbase
activities.description: §7Letvus Airbase is the best place to go for commercial airship travel, though only the wealthiest can afford it.

activities.name: Lexdale
activities.description: §7This slumlike town has suffered the worst of the Decay's effects over the years, after its residents were forced out of their original homes by an unfortunate event.

activities.name: Lexdale Penitentiary
activities.description: §7Feared as the highest security prison in all of Gavel, this towering stronghold has held the worst criminals within its walls for centuries. In recent years, however, rumors have spread that they have begun arresting innocent citizens...

activities.name: Light Forest Gate
activities.description: §7This serves as the gateway to the brilliant Light Forest. Unlike the Dark Forest, this area hasn't been afflicted by the Decay, and remains as beautiful as ever.

activities.name: Llevigar
activities.description: §7The city of Llevigar is the first sight adventurers see in Gavel. It was built using quartz mined from the nearby Karoc Quarry. It is the most advanced city in Gavel.

activities.name: Lusuco
activities.description: §7In even the harshest of cold, the people of Lusuco have stayed put and continued living here.

activities.name: Maex
activities.description: §7A dwarven town founded as a monument to the victory in Molten Heights. It was built by the power of the people. Dwarves are communal and riches are owned by all.

activities.name: Mage Island
activities.description: §7Home to the reclusive mages responsible for calming the waves, the people on this island continue to study magic and advance their capabilities beyond any other.

activities.name: Magmastream Core
activities.description: §7Leading to the very heart of the tallest Volcano Isle, this tunnel almost feels alive- Magically-charged lava flows like a bloodstream around you. Small crystals are visible within the lavastreams on occasion.

activities.name: Maltic
activities.description: §7The first town founded by Villagers in the Wynn province. Maltic's beach is the site of a shipwreck that crashed upon its shores 100 years ago.

activities.name: Maro Peaks
activities.description: §7Proposals to colonise Maro Peaks have long been brought up as it holds great defensive and industrial benefits, but the local animal population proves impossible to work with. It is said Bob was the first man to climb to the peak.

activities.name: Molten Heights Gate
activities.description: §7The entryway to the Molten Heights, a fiery den of volcanoes. It's the home of the Dwarves, and the last remaining Doguns.

activities.name: Monument to Siegfried
activities.description: §7Built by the most skilled sculptors in Gavel, no expense was spared in constructing this enormous monument to Gavel's hero.

activities.name: Nemract
activities.description: §7Nemract is an under-defended, rough, seafaring city. The people here have endured a lot of suffering - and that has made them hardy.

activities.name: Nesaak
activities.description: §7In the center of the unnaturally frozen forest lies the small town of Nesaak. Their main source of food is ice fishing.

activities.name: Nest of the Grootslangs
activities.description: §7Just beyond this now abandoned ruin lies a dug out nest crawling with infantile Grootslangs. If left to mature, these newborn creatures will grow powerful enough to decimate the swamp.

activities.name: Nivla Woods
activities.description: §7This forest has been infested with giant, mutant arachnids for countless years. They serve as the greatest obstacle for adventurers on their way to Detlas.

activities.name: North Lusuco
activities.description: §7High up in the mountains, this area serves as the site of Lusuco's annual Wynnter Fair.

activities.name: Olmic Cathedral
activities.description: §7This old cathedral has fallen into disrepair, especially considering the massive spike that's grown inside of it. Legends say that beneath the cathedral lies a powerful rune.

activities.name: Olux
activities.description: §7Olux is a poor town, one that has suffered the effects of the Decay, a force that has caused all of north-western Gavel to begin to wither.

activities.name: Olux Lumber Yard
activities.description: §7Once used for repairs for Olux's massive wall, the lumber yard has become useless after the Decay began to make the trees rot and die.

activities.name: Orphion's Nexus of Light
activities.description: §7Thought only to be a myth, this legendary structure acts as a nexus for the Realm of Light's power. Somewhere within its enigmatic halls lies Orphion, the physical manifestation of Light itself.

activities.name: Owl Tribe
activities.description: §7The Owl Tribe is one of the two native tribes of the Rymek Canyon. They have been at war with the Eagle Tribe for years.

activities.name: Ozoth's Spire
activities.description: §7Tainted by the flames, this spire serves as the dramatic trail up to the nest of the dragon herself, Ozoth.

activities.name: Pigmen's Ravine
activities.description: §7This massive, maze-like ravine is home to the Pigmen, a species of half-pig, half-human abominations that feast on any weak adventurer who happens to stumble inside.

activities.name: Pirate Cove
activities.description: §7Founded by the first seafarer Redbeard, Pirate Cove is home to some of the most dangerous men in the ocean. They set up outposts all around the island to seek out merchant ships to plunder.

activities.name: Pirate's Bay
activities.description: §7A massive pirate ship crashed here with such severity, the hull was moulded into the cliffside. Some say that there is still treasure hidden inside.

activities.name: Plague Laboratory
activities.description: §7Mold, viscera, chemicals, and waste combine to give this laboratory a disgusting smell. Filth seems to cover every inch of this place.

activities.name: Portal to Dern
activities.description: §7Thought to be only a myth, this portal's existence confirms the legends that the Silent Expanse is a road to Dern. How to access it, though, is perhaps a mystery that can't be solved yet...

activities.name: Prison of Souls
activities.description: §7Oppressively dark and enigmatic, simply being inside this cave makes you feel disconnected from your body. Horrific power permeates the area...

activities.name: Quartz Mansion
activities.description: §7A group of bandits who have been stealing quartz shipments hide out in this mansion. However, no one knows what they're using it for.

activities.name: Ragni
activities.description: §7One of two great fortresses in Wynn. Ragni has survived over 1000 years of war - sometimes barely. It is the hometown of the 146 year old hero Bob, who hasn't been seen in 16 years.

activities.name: Raiders' Port
activities.description: §7Home of the Sky Raiders, a group of pirates who plunder and thieve through the air.

activities.name: Relos
activities.description: §7This coastal town is sprawling with gears and machinery built by the various engineers and mechanics living there. Importing and exporting take place frequently here.

activities.name: River Sage
activities.description: §7This is the widest river in Gavel, and stretches so long that it divides the plains in two.

activities.name: Rodoroc
activities.description: §7The capital of the Dwarven dominated Molten Heights. Carved from the rocks by the power of the people, it stands as one of the strongest cities ever made.

activities.name: Rooster Island
activities.description: §7This egg-shaped island is home to a single resident, a featherbrained villager hermit obsessed over chickens. Rumor has it that Bob has visited the island for some reason.

activities.name: Roots of Corruption
activities.description: §7A thousand years ago, a group of emerald miners unearthed a mysterious portal. Unknowingly, they doomed the province to centuries of war against the mysterious force known as corruption.

activities.name: Rotten Passage
activities.description: §7This tunnel seems to have been dug out unnaturally. The groans of the undead echo and clash in the fetid cavern air.

activities.name: Ruined Olmic City
activities.description: §7Though its creators have disappeared, this city serves as proof that there was once a civilization in the Silent Expanse.

activities.name: Rymek
activities.description: §7The town of Rymek was founded by the Creden Tibus bandit group. They only deal exchanges through a special currency.

activities.name: Sanctuary Bridge
activities.description: §7This magnificent bridge connects the mysterious ruins of Time Valley to the frigid cold of the Nesaak Tundra. In the center lies a mysterious seal that no one has been able to open.

activities.name: Savannah
activities.description: §7Wild ocelots inhabit this mostly-barren savannah, which leads to the Almuj desert. There is a town on the edge of the mountains, though few visit it.

activities.name: Seavale Reef
activities.description: §7Ocean currents flow and intertwine to form these renowned reefs, bursting with life. Tourists frequently dive and discover lost treasure, dropped from merchant ships and carried by the currents.

activities.name: Selchar
activities.description: §7Founded in 970 AP after the waves calmed, this city became the bridge between Gavel and Wynn. It flourishes in trade and enjoys a safe haven from the dangers of both provinces.

activities.name: Silverbull Company Headquarters
activities.description: §7Previously a summer residence for the Gavellian Monarchy, it had fallen into disrepair in the years since the fall of the Royalty. Several years ago, it was bought out and renovated by the Silverbull Trading Company to serve as their headquarters for business expansion.

activities.name: Skiens Island
activities.description: §7Held down by a fanatical military leader, their efforts prevented the colonization of Selchar for years. Somehow, the symptoms of corruption have begun, despite its position in the sea.

activities.name: Soosu's Mansion
activities.description: §7The seldom-seen Sovereign of the Roughworks, Soosu, is known to almost always be huddled up in this haphazard tower. What she does in there is anyone's guess.

activities.name: Sunrise Canyon
activities.description: §7A secluded gorge, rumored to be the territory of a notorious lone bandit. The stones turn a fiery spectrum of colors in the sunrise and set.

activities.name: Taproot
activities.description: §7In the midst of Decay, a massive amount of light is emanating from this root.

activities.name: Temple of Legends
activities.description: §7Only the most revered of scholars and adventurers are allowed inside of the Temple of Legends. Just entering this place is a testament to your victory against the Corrupter of Worlds.

activities.name: Ternaves
activities.description: §7This small town has laid quietly near Detlas for decades. Nearby lies a massive prison that few draw near.

activities.name: Thanos
activities.description: §7The only residence of dwarves outside of the Molten Heights, Thanos has been threatened by Ozoth, a powerful dragon feared across the entire province.

activities.name: The Canopy's Hideout
activities.description: §7With little government assistance, the people of the Mistwoods depend on various clans to keep them safe from the forest's mysterious threats. One such clan is The Canopy.

activities.name: The Canyon Colossus
activities.description: §7A sight to behold, this enormous statue has resided in the Canyon of the Lost for as long as history can tell. Its magic permeates throughout the entire canyon, making it nigh-impossible to navigate.

activities.name: The Eldritch Outlook
activities.description: §7It is impossible to tell the origins of this peculiar structure, but it might be the tallest in the known world. Climbing to the top could provide a great view.

activities.name: The Forgery
activities.description: §7While this may look like a simple bridge on the way to Cinfras, above it floats The Forgery, the gateway to Corrupted Dungeons.

activities.name: The Frog Bog
activities.description: §7The water that once circulated Auburn has long since stagnated. The lack of drainage to the ocean has caused a freshwater swamp to slowly develop in this corner of the forest. Spooky stories about what lies within the bog have led to it being an unfavourable place to live.

activities.name: The Gateway to Light
activities.description: §7Secluded beneath the remains of a colossal tree, this bizarre structure acts as a gateway to the Realm of Light, an otherworldly realm beyond imagination.

activities.name: The Great Bridge
activities.description: §7While it is unknown when it was built, this bridge serves as one of the only ways to access the Jungle. Usually the bustling of travelers and salesmen alike echoes throughout its halls...

activities.name: The Guild Hall
activities.description: §7The Guild Hall is where the most prestigious guilds gather, and where you can create your own. You can also get to Letvus Airbase through here.

activities.name: The Highlands
activities.description: §7Ever in bloom, the Highlands are home to those in Fruma who are fortunate enough to be a part of the upper-class. Lavish mansions inhabited by the aristocracy litter the region's gorgeous hills.

activities.name: The House of Twain
activities.description: §7Once the home of the most gifted defenders of Wynn, it now lies in ruins and haunted by the spirits that could not move on.

activities.name: The Industrial District
activities.description: §7Known to its inhabitants as the Roughworks, this region of the Province is devoted to the manufacture of products for richer areas. Its citizens toil endlessly, rewarded with a mere pittance - hardly enough to survive.

activities.name: The Mistwoods
activities.description: §7A dense fog permanently covers this vast redwood forest, meaning no outsider can see any more than just the towering treetops. As such, few know what goes on within the woods, which citizens are barred from entering.

activities.name: The Moon
activities.description: §7It seems the wizard's gravity spell made you fall all the way through space, landing on the moon itself. Weird.

activities.name: The Outer Void
activities.description: §7A strange aura emanating from a forgotten refuse within the Void has warped the gravity surrounding it, pulling in all sorts of fallen debris. An opportunity to exploit for some, a dangerous omen for others.

activities.name: The Palace
activities.description: §7Home to the Queen, this vast palace is the very heart of Fruma. It is filled with luxuries for Her Majesty to enjoy, for just like the province itself, it exists only to please her.

activities.name: The Qira Hive
activities.description: §7This towering nest is the Qira Hive, a challenge against the powerful creations of the enigmatic Qira.

activities.name: The Royal Dam
activities.description: §7This towering Dam restricts the flow of water from the Highlands into the Auburn Forest. The Crown claims it is to protect the citizens.

activities.name: The Royal University of Aelumia
activities.description: §7Colloquially known as Aelumia University, it is the most prestigious educational institution in Fruma. Many of the province's greatest minds have studied here, some later going on to become Sovereigns.

activities.name: The Shiar
activities.description: §7A village of hobbits, it is home to a blacksmith by the name of Dodegar, seeking to forge the ultimate weapon.

activities.name: The Steel Feather
activities.description: §7In this abandoned subway station, a group of citizens wronged by the government have gathered, building their own community beneath the eyes of the Crown.

activities.name: The Void
activities.description: §7A thousand meters beneath the Sky Islands, the remains of a fractured land linger. Strange forces warp its inhabitants, molding them for survival in unfamiliar conditions.

activities.name: The Wellspring of Eternity
activities.description: §7Home to one of the most beautiful gardens in Fruma, this royal bathhouse is off-limits to everyone but its staff, the Queen, and her Sovereigns - and as such, is guarded quite heavily. One must wonder what makes it so special...

activities.name: Thesead
activities.description: §7Thesead is one of the more isolated cities of Gavel, but its coal industry has kept it thriving. However, recently the coal mines have been ridden with an unusual gas.

activities.name: Timasca
activities.description: §7Although it is the most urban area of the Roughworks, the bar is not very high. The city is constantly growing and redeveloping, unmindful of what came before, resulting in its ramshackle state.

activities.name: Time Valley
activities.description: §7The ruins here have been present longer than the portal. Only one person alive today understands this strange place. Time acts strangely here and it's apparent that whoever made them were not human.

activities.name: Tower of Ascension
activities.description: §7The tallest tower in the province, the Tower of Ascension provides a challenge so daunting that it has brought down even the strongest of warriors.

activities.name: Town of Lutho
activities.description: §7A sight to behold, this eccentric town's glowing obelisk is a beacon of hope in the midst of the Silent Expanse.

activities.name: Toxic Wastes
activities.description: §7An area unlike any other, the green slime seems to move in symphony across the land. The unbearable smell and acidity makes it almost impossible to live in.

activities.name: Tribal Sanctuary
activities.description: §7This disused Iboju burial site seems to have been turned into a camp for the risen tribal zombies. Foreign chanting is a constant ambience here.

activities.name: Troms
activities.description: §7This massive fortress has served as a symbol of hope to the province throughout the war. Its army has helped keep the corruption at bay for centuries.

activities.name: Troms Castle
activities.description: §7The royal family of Troms has been the talk of the town lately. The king's son has gone missing, while the King himself remains reclusive and paranoid...

activities.name: Upper Molten Heights
activities.description: §7The volcanoes stand upon a hollow victory and support the few survivors of the war. Some argue it was a genocide, not a war.

activities.name: Void Valley
activities.description: §7This valley has been overgrown with gigantic plant life. Rumors suggest that small rifts in the ground allow one to teleport.

activities.name: Void Village
activities.description: §7Most perished during the fracturing of the Sky Islands one thousand years ago, but a few could count themselves fortunate enough to survive the fall. Here they gather together, clinging to what little hope they have left.

activities.name: Volcanic Isles
activities.description: §7Mostly inhospitable, the islands are a relatively new formation. WynnExcavation has set up Excavation Site C here in hopes to find valuable new minerals.

activities.name: Worm Holes
activities.description: §7These massive holes have recently begun appearing all around the swamp, creating a massive tunnel network underground.

activities.name: WynnExcavation Site A
activities.description: §7WynnExcavation is a Gavel-owned company dedicated to uncovering the history of the Wynn Province. Here, they've uncovered an ancient tomb from a lost empire.

activities.name: WynnExcavation Site B
activities.description: §7No one knows what WynnExcavation is searching for at Site B, but rumors are circulating that they are trying to uncover something ancient and powerful.

activities.name: WynnExcavation Site D
activities.description: §7It is said that the Leaf Crystal was buried here. Once WynnExcavation finds it, they'll have all four of the crystals scattered across Wynn, granting them unfathomable power.

activities.name: Zhight Island
activities.description: §7This small community is an up-and-coming tourist attraction for its fair weather and tropically-themed luxuries, requiring constant shipping to the island to maintain business.

activities.name: Abandoned Steelworks
activities.description: §7The forgotten factory at §f[-1832, 33, -794]§7 may not be so empty after all.

activities.name: Abyssal Shine
activities.description: §7In a cave dark as the depths of the ocean, shining stalks grow and attract glowing moths at §f[604, 31, -5074]§7, and...?

activities.name: Aelumia Chemical Plant
activities.description: §7The acrid smell of ammonia mixes with the stench of synthetic solvents near the chemical plant at §f[-1510, 133, -753]

activities.name: Aelumia Metalmill
activities.description: §7Pipes, gears, springs, bearings, all kinds of metalwork is sculpted in the mill at §f[-1500, 131, -808]

activities.name: Aelumia Weaveworks
activities.description: §7Thread is spun through colossal looms into cloth and textile within the fabric mill at §f[-1523, 132, -737]

activities.name: Ancestor Grotto
activities.description: §7A tiny cave of corrupted Old Timers at §f[-628, 49, -1953]

activities.name: Ancient Arthropods
activities.description: §7Something has broken free from the amber within the cave at §f[-2058, 25, -1479]

activities.name: Angel Falls
activities.description: §7Angels taken refuge inside the islands at §f[1026, 110, -4697]

activities.name: Aquaculture Aquifer
activities.description: §7A strange old Aquifer has fertile soil and has been converted into a subterranean farm at §f[-1930, 84, -3325]§7 Yet a famine lies at its deepest core

activities.name: Auburn Lumbermill
activities.description: §7The cogs within the lumbermill at §f[-1836, 11, -1035]§7 continue to grind away the local woodland

activities.name: Avos Animation Totem
activities.description: §7Beware what lives at §f[-1759, 38, -2450]

activities.name: Azer Athenaeum
activities.description: §7The Azer who wish to learn and wish to fight make home at §f[1511, 49, -5176]

activities.name: Azurite Island
activities.description: §7A crazed crystal and the madman who took it lies at §f[953, 142, -4761]

activities.name: Bandit Groundbreaking
activities.description: §7The bandits menacing the Cinfras County are trying to dig a new hideout at §f[-287, 46, -5552]

activities.name: Basalt Basin
activities.description: §7Dying embers of what appears to be a volcano past its prime lies at §f[-557, 32, -460]

activities.name: Bird Sanctuary
activities.description: §7A flock of birds gathered in a cave around §f[-928, 31, -410] §7Some say a strange person lives deep in the cave among them

activities.name: Blaze Springs
activities.description: §7Beware the blaze infestation at the lava spring near §f[828, 49, -5353]

activities.name: Blazing Oasis
activities.description: §7Even in an awe inspiring subterranean ecosystem, corruption makes its Oasis §f[924, 76, -1349]

activities.name: Blind Burrow
activities.description: §7Senses gone missing in a twisted evolution have resulted in the burrows at §f[1393, 164, -1055]

activities.name: Boar Burrow
activities.description: §7A massive colony of boars have burrowed their way into a cavern at §f[-227, 57, -2097]

activities.name: Bovine Bedrock
activities.description: §7Bedrock has shot out the ground, and some strange bovine creatures have made it home at §f[-608, 49, -4904]

activities.name: Breaking Ice
activities.description: §7A cave covered in thin ice and full of rocky creatures around §f[-134, 74, -797]

activities.name: Broodmother's Bestiary
activities.description: §7Harpies have taken to the mountaintops with a path beginning near §f[645, 92, -5328]

activities.name: Builder-Bot Central
activities.description: §7Builder bots have gone past their programming and are making strange masonry structures inside a cave at §f[-1674, 53, -3060]

activities.name: Burning Bog
activities.description: §7Kandrekk warlocks have claimed a bog hidden behind ancient Gylia Ruins at §f[-411, 38, -5205]§7, and seek to watch the world burn

activities.name: Caged Creatures
activities.description: §7The caretakers have become the pets. Rules are upturned in a twisted spectacle, hidden away at §f[1134, 136, -1121]

activities.name: Captain's Quarters
activities.description: §7Find a drunken pirate captain in his underground hideout around §f[561, 39, -2085]

activities.name: Carnadile Den
activities.description: §7The Carnadiles make their den around §f[-725, 65, -731]

activities.name: Cave Springs
activities.description: §7A cave spring full of life around §f[310, 60, -1851]

activities.name: Cave of Doom
activities.description: §7Enter the cave of demons at §f[1405, 29, -5067]§7 and wait for a great monster to appear.

activities.name: Cave of the Seasons
activities.description: §7Light and the seasons have taken physical form under a strange tree growing out of §f[-864, 52, -6131]

activities.name: Chiseler's Cavern
activities.description: §7Long abandoned, constructed gargoyles in various states of decay guard a cave near §f[622, 32, -4695]

activities.name: Citadel Catacombs
activities.description: §7Old ruins carved into the side of the tableland Aelumia Citadel rests upon at §f[-1505, 80, -733]§7 have become the spawning ground for various unsavory creatures and foliage.

activities.name: Colossi Infection
activities.description: §7The roots of the Colossi structures snakes through the valley like veins and arteries, and are sometimes exposed, like at §f[323, 69, -4633]

activities.name: Corkus Quarry
activities.description: §7LAZERS and explosives are being used by the bots to dig out a massive quarry at §f[-1365, 94, -2736]

activities.name: Corrupt Time Warp
activities.description: §7Enter an old Time Valley temple and experience the effects of the corrupted crystal inside §f[-332, 69, -1301]

activities.name: Corrupted Passageway
activities.description: §7A Passageway with a Mysterious door §f[-497, 69, -1630]§7 Perhaps a key could be found on some nearby structure.

activities.name: Corruption Mines
activities.description: §7A mine from old times completely consumed by The Roots of Corruption §f[170, 71, -1187]

activities.name: Crab Fighters
activities.description: §7A chaotic underground crab fighting ring at §f[-799, 40, -1965]

activities.name: Cryovern Covert
activities.description: §7A covert of Cryovern lies up in the Frozen Heights around §f[1526, 68, -5427]

activities.name: Crypt Excavation
activities.description: §7Miners on an excavation have been corrupted! Find loot left behind around §f[-32, 70, -1432]

activities.name: Crystal Caverns
activities.description: §7Rumors say that the deepest parts of this cavern are covered in a purple crystal §f[1120, 76, -2177]

activities.name: Crystalline Polynya
activities.description: §7Sea ice and crystalline creatures converge in a cavern below the waves at §f[1203, 37, -2937]

activities.name: Cultists Passage
activities.description: §7Cultists have taken refuge in a small passageway around §f[-1261, 46, -4460]

activities.name: Cyclonic Spirit Trap
activities.description: §7Spirits trapped by the canyon walls are funneled by the wind to caves such as the one at §f[600, 40, -5266]§7, and...?

activities.name: Cyclopes' Shrine
activities.description: §7Cyclopes fight trolls to claim an old shrine at §f[51, 47, -4456]

activities.name: Dead Man's Dugout
activities.description: §7The dead remains of pirates past live at §f[853, 37, -2448]

activities.name: Demolition Derby
activities.description: §7Hobgoblins seem interested in exploding an obstruction near §f[590, 30, -4625]

activities.name: Derelict Mine
activities.description: §7A mine boarded up to keep dangers inside at §f[-627, 73, -1760]

activities.name: Deserter's Camp
activities.description: §7A group of Gavellian army deserters are hiding in a cave underneath the path around §f[499, 80, -5299]

activities.name: Detlas Salt Mine
activities.description: §7The Detlas salt mine has been overrun with the corrupt at §f[21, 64, -1767]

activities.name: Dragon Delta
activities.description: §7Feed the great dragon statue, and find what remains inside the ancient beast at §f[1259, 48, -5343]

activities.name: Dragonkin Nest
activities.description: §7Poachers say, if you gather the scales from the Draconic nests and bring them to the large nest at §f[1464, 173, -5529]§7 you can find great reward.

activities.name: Drone's Retreat
activities.description: §7The only creatures to ever have escaped the Qira Hive's strict watch hide away in the mountains at §f[235, 126, -5423]

activities.name: Dullahan Gardens
activities.description: §7Deep in the castle gardens you'll find many a dangerous creature around §f[-1132, 83, -5684]

activities.name: Dust Bowl
activities.description: §7Dust storms and creatures have taken life in this mine at §f[1003, 74, -1704]

activities.name: Earth Eaters
activities.description: §7The earth is being eaten away by strange creatures around §f[-1388, 46, -4981]

activities.name: Electrifying Outpost
activities.description: §7A small watchtower sits at §f[-1916,25,-1198]§7. It is run by only a handful of soldiers, and could be easy to loot...

activities.name: Elemental Hollow
activities.description: §7Chaotic conglomerations of elemental energies appear and threaten Gelibord at §f[-1110, 48, -5290]

activities.name: Emerald Knives Hideout
activities.description: §7The Emerald Knives are hoarding their ill-gotten gains in an old mine at §f[1338, 80, -1705]

activities.name: Entozoon Takeover
activities.description: §7Giant worms thrive on the rotting roots of an old redwood stump at §f[-1186, 49, -640]§7.

activities.name: Estalis Gallery
